title: 第十六章 拜师第十七章 修罗斗场
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 冯斗收回灵气之后，他发觉自己的变化，他马上进入自己的灵气海之中，他向幻仙跪下来，他说：“请大师收我为徒！”
其实这个就是冯斗在得到了空间道这一本书籍的，虽然这一部书只是上部，但是此时已经让他感受到极大的好处，他不是傻子，自然明白幻仙的身上绝对有很多不是他能够想象得到的。
他希望能够得到更加多的传承，所以他才想要拜幻仙为师，因为他知道幻仙绝对不是表面上看得那么简单的，有太多的东西是他所不知道的，更加坚定了他要拜幻仙为师的决心。
幻仙当然能够看得出冯斗的这一点点小心思，然而幻仙却知道一些冯斗根本不可能知道的东西，他还是不希望和冯斗身后势力有太多关联，毕竟现在的他还不具备与它抗衡的力量。
如果按照幻仙以前的实力来说，他根本不会害怕冯斗身后的势力，但是他现在只是寄宿于冯斗的灵气海之中，但是他现在实力最多只有之前不到百分之一的灵气，根本没有办法做到真正的强者。
只不过算得上一般强者，但是相当于冯斗这样的灵修者来说，算得上绝对的强者。
幻仙此时说：“臭小子，我真的越来越服了你的，我可以教你，但是我不可以当你的老师，至于是什么原因，你以后会慢慢地明白的，我现在就详细和你说了。”
当然得到这个结果，他绝对不会满意的，毕竟能够成为幻仙的徒弟，和幻仙答应教他完全不是一回事的。
冯斗当然愿意接受前者，因为这样是绝对的不一样的。
可是现在幻仙仅仅答应教冯斗，这一点绝对不能够让他满意的，可是都好过没有的，正是因为这个原因，到最后冯斗都是勉强接受这个提议。
冯斗转眼间已经修炼接近三年时间，他马上退出灵气海，他现在需要去报名参加药神界所组织的初级赛，只有这样他才能够得到其他人注意力。
他才可以找到自己的家族，得到他想知道的一切，因为很多东西都是他需要急缺得到的，只有这样才最快的时间得到。
所以很多时候冯斗无法去想象太多的其他想法，因为对于现在的他来说，只有能够找到自己的家族，那么就算再辛苦，他也是一样的。
冯斗并没有急着修炼，因为幻仙曾经说过，一个人想要修炼之路走得远，就绝对不能够一味修炼，这样只会让自己的修炼之路越来越窄了，最后只会钻进牛角尖啦！
其实修炼分为两个部分，第一个就是修，第二个就是炼，所以这样来说，只是注重炼而放弃了修的人，这样只会让自己走进死胡同的，当初冯斗也是觉得自己只是注重炼，忽略的修的重要性。
其实修远远要比炼重要得多的，修能够帮助炼巩固自己的修为，只有这样才能够真正地做到万无一失，自己的修为才不会因此而变得不完美。
所以他决定要选择一条只是合适自己的修炼之路，只有这样才摸索到一条属于自己的路，有时候路是需要自己不断地摸索的。
现在的冯斗在店家那边得到了一些信息，这次药神界的初级赛，除了炼药大赛之外，还有就是修罗斗场，修罗斗场和药神界同属于灵修大陆顶级的神秘组织，没有人知道它的来历，正是因为这样，很少人会知道它们到底属于什么样的势力，同时极少人会因此而得罪这些势力。
曾经一个极为高阶的灵修者，因为私自乱闯了修罗斗场，然而就算因为这个，引起显然大波，被人连续追杀了接近三十年，最后他因为被同等级的十个强者围攻，一点也没有反抗的余力，直接给击杀了。
从此之后，再无人敢去挑战修罗斗场，一直都是敬而远之的。

After Feng Dou took back his spiritual energy, he noticed his changes. He immediately entered his own spiritual energy sea. He knelt down to Huanxian and said, "Master, please accept me as your disciple!"
In fact, this is why Feng Dou got the book "Space Dao". Although this book is only the upper part, it has already given him great benefits. He is not a fool, and naturally understands that there are definitely many things in Huanxian that he cannot imagine.
He hoped to get more inheritance, so he wanted to worship Huanxian as his teacher, because he knew that Huanxian was definitely not as simple as it seemed on the surface. There were too many things that he didn't know, which strengthened his determination to worship Huanxian as his teacher.
Of course Huanxian can see this little bit of Feng Dou's little thoughts, but Huanxian knows something that Feng Dou cannot possibly know. He still doesn't want to have too much to do with the forces behind Feng Dou. After all, he doesn't have the power to compete with it now.
Based on Huanxian's previous strength, he would not be afraid of the forces behind Feng Dou at all, but now he is only living in Feng Dou's sea of ​​spiritual energy, but his current strength is at most less than one percent of his previous spiritual energy, and there is no way to become a truly strong man.
He can only be regarded as an average strong person, but for a spiritual cultivator like Feng Dou, he can be regarded as an absolute strong person.
Huanxian said at this time: "You brat, I'm really more and more convinced of you. I can teach you, but I can't be your teacher. As for the reason, you will slowly understand it in the future. I will tell you in detail now."
Of course, he would never be satisfied with this result. After all, being able to become Huanxian's apprentice was completely different from Huanxian's promise to teach him.
Of course Feng Dou is willing to accept the former, because this is absolutely different.
But now Huanxian only agreed to teach Feng Dou, which was definitely not satisfactory to him, but it was better than nothing. It was for this reason that Feng Dou reluctantly accepted the proposal in the end.
Feng Dou had been practicing for nearly three years in the blink of an eye. He immediately quit the spiritual energy sea. He now needs to sign up for the preliminary competition organized by the Medicine God Realm. Only in this way can he get the attention of others.
Only then can he find his family and get everything he wants to know, because there are many things he needs urgently, and only in this way can he get them in the fastest time.
So many times Feng Dou can't imagine too many other ideas, because for him now, as long as he can find his family, then no matter how hard it is, he will be the same.
Feng Dou was not in a hurry to practice, because Huan Xian once said that if a person wants to go far in practice, he must not practice blindly. This will only make his path of practice narrower and narrower, and in the end he will only get into trouble!
In fact, cultivation is divided into two parts, the first is cultivation, and the second is practice. So in this way, those who only focus on cultivation and give up on cultivation will only lead themselves into a dead end. At the beginning, Feng Dou also felt that he only focused on cultivation and ignored the importance of cultivation.
In fact, cultivation is far more important than practice. Cultivation can help practice and consolidate your own cultivation. Only in this way can you truly be foolproof and your own cultivation will not become imperfect because of this.
So he decided to choose a path of cultivation that was suitable for him. Only in this way could he find a path of his own. Sometimes the path required constant exploration on his own.
Now Feng Dou got some information from the store. This time, in addition to the medicine refining competition, there is also the Shura Arena. The Shura Arena and the Medicine God Realm both belong to the top mysterious organizations in the spiritual cultivation continent. No one knows its origin. Because of this, few people know what kind of forces they belong to, and very few people will offend these forces.
There was once an extremely high-level spiritual cultivator who broke into the Shura Arena privately. However, even because of this, he caused a huge stir and was continuously hunted for nearly thirty years. In the end, he was besieged by ten strong men of the same level and had no room to resist, so he was killed directly.
From then on, no one dared to challenge Shura Arena, and they always stayed away.
